title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: Where did you go on your vacation?
I went to Seattle with my family.
The scenery was fantastic and it took my breath away.
sentences.zh: 风景太棒了，令我惊叹不已。

sentences.en: We stayed in a comfortable hotel near the station.
sentences.zh: 我们住在车站附近一家舒适的旅馆。

sentences.en: Were you bored during the trip?
sentences.zh: 旅行期间你觉得无聊吗？

sentences.en: No, there was nothing but fun!
Thousands of people visit this ancient town every year.
sentences.zh: 每年有成千上万的人参观这座古镇。

sentences.en: Don't forget your passport and your scarf.
sentences.zh: 别忘了你的护照和围巾。

sentences.en: I will never forget this happy holiday.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记这个快乐的假期。
